name: HawkPath
description: Experimental Geometry Dash pathfinding research mod with a fail-closed safety gate. Route execution is disabled and the physics model is uncalibrated in this release.

show-event-log.name: Show Event Log
show-event-log.description: Show the event log card in the HawkPath dashboard.

ui-refresh-interval.name: Dashboard Refresh Interval
ui-refresh-interval.description: How often (in seconds) the dashboard refreshes its status. Cosmetic only; it cannot affect safety checks.
